decision.observation: Hornet stands left of the hub wheel-bench near the small mushroom, on the stone-tiled walkway. HUD: rosary icon, three mask cones, three dark rosebud pips, needle gauge.
decision.hypothesis: The hub wheel resists Up even when flush, so it may not be a usable bench here. The western green grotto's central light shaft has stacked, round mossy platforms that have never been climbed and could lead to an upper exit. Head west along the walkway.
decision.memory: Moss Grotto loops: hub wheel room, west grotto with light shafts and stacked platforms (unclimbed), bush passage, lit pocket + pillar/coral chamber (dead end), dark bench pocket with pale burst-creature (gave upgrades + Bind).
